primary_treatment: One deterministic augmentation of retrieval queries from positive MAY claim action types. NLI premise packing settings and the original source hypothesis remain unchanged.

tokenization.accepted_for_recognition: ASCII only, case-insensitive; re.findall([a-z]+) over lowercase source hypothesis
tokenization.unicode_fallback: Keep original hypothesis exactly; no expansion
tokenization.modal: Exactly one token may; parse action only immediately following it

recognizer_rule: Exactly one matching action predicate, otherwise retain original query. No model or label selection.
formula: original hypothesis + newline + Retrieval terms: + space-joined fixed predicate terms, iff recognized; otherwise identical original string
BGE_query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
truncation: Forbidden; any over-cap original or expanded whole query is an execution error, never clipped or switched to another policy.
native_query_order: Per case original then expanded, sharing the exact same document vector index and k/config.

four_arm_contract.native_original: Original-query native hits; causal query control on same index/model/doc
four_arm_contract.lexical: Jaccard ranking using exactly the same expanded query string
four_arm_contract.positional: First source units, no query ranking

model_hypothesis: Original unmodified source hypothesis in all four arms.
proof_scope: Exposed engineering regression only. DEV proof disabled; DEV final probabilities exactly raw T1 in every arm. No proof efficacy claim.
